Maya Patel: Heads up — seeing a 10-25% tail latency regression on the INT4 path for sm89 once seqlen crosses 1024. Probe run attached. :eyes:

Maya Patel: ```
[perf] model=redwood-std-13b quant=INT4 arch=sm89 seq=1024->1025 kern=quant_pack_v2 pick=pathB latency_p99=120ms -> 150ms
kv_cache_hit=0.22 -> 0.05
batch_size=1
```

Sam O'Neil: Interesting. Did the autotuner flip kernel selector recently? @Jordana any heuristics changes this week?

Jordana Li: I rolled a hysteresis tweak on Tue that biases FP8 for mid seqs to avoid memory spikes. Could be interacting with quant selection. :thinking_face:

Maya Patel: I reproduced locally on h100-sm89 and also ran a quick on sm92. sm92 is fine, only sm89 spikes. Looks like per-arch pick table mismatch around the 1k boundary.

Eli Torres: FWIW traces show KV cache churn when the kernel pick flips mid-generation. KV retention drops and we pay mem-copy instead of reuse. Small excerpt: ```KV_SWAP: evict=24 reuse=3 -> 0.7```

ci-bot: probechain job 2125001234 started by Maya Patel
ci-bot: probechain result: 4/5 nodes OK, 1 regressed (sm89). Report: https://internal.redwood/probe/2125001234 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sam O'Neil: Can someone run: ```probechain --force-route=pathA --no-warmup --trace-kv``` and also ```probechain --force-route=pathB --trace-kv```. Compare pickbench flamegraphs and kernel selection logs.

Jordana Li: Queuing those now. Also proposing a safety-matrix for the autotuner: require 2 consecutive seq bins before switching quant kernel pick (i.e., avoid flip on single-token crossing). Example config: `SEQLEN_STABILITY=2`.

Maya Patel: Good idea. If probe confirms, I'll roll back the hysteresis change and open a follow-up to make the tuner arch-aware for INT4 thresholds.

Eli Torres: Also add a KV-consistency check to the runtime: if kv_cache_hit drops > 50% immediately after a pick flip, prefer previous pick for remainder of request. That should avoid mid-gen stalls.

Sam O'Neil: +1. Can we log a compact "pick-delta" event to make postmortems easier? e.g., `PICK_DELTA {old:new, seq_before, seq_after, kv_hit_delta}`.

Jordana Li: Will add PICK_DELTA and tests to the probe harness. Queued jobs ETA ~25m.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Tagging this as perf/regression and adding to the rollout watchlist. :thumbsup:
